source.section: Form 540 lines 13 to 19 and 31 to 33 (PDF pages 39-40); PDF page 13 Line 18 standard deduction chart and Line 31; PDF page 75 Tax Rate Schedules; PDF page 16 Line 62 Behavioral Health Services Tax worksheet lines 1 to 5; PDF page 40 Form 540 lines 48, 62 and 64

worked: Single, 55: wages 1,200,000; federal AGI = 1,200,000. Taxable income over 1,000,000 takes the 1% Behavioral Health Services Tax, which the projection folds into a 13.3% band from 1,000,000. Form 540 line 13 federal AGI = 1,200,000.00. Federal taxable income = 1,200,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 1,184,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Subtractions: none (wages need no adjustment). Form 540 line 14 = 0.00. Additions (line 16): 0.00. Line 15 = line 17 California AGI = 1,200,000.00 - 0.00 = 1,200,000.00. Line 18 California standard deduction (single, PDF page 13 chart) 5,706.00. Line 19 taxable income = 1,200,000.00 - 5,706.00 = 1,194,294.00. Tax on 1,194,294.00 by the projection's brackets: 11,079.00 x 1% = 110.79; 15,185.00 x 2% = 303.70; 15,188.00 x 4% = 607.52; 16,090.00 x 6% = 965.40; 15,182.00 x 8% = 1,214.56; 298,755.00 x 9.3% = 27,784.215; 74,292.00 x 10.3% = 7,652.076; 297,182.00 x 11.3% = 33,581.566; 257,047.00 x 12.3% = 31,616.781; 194,294.00 x 13.3% = 25,841.102; total 129,677.71. Line 11 exemptions: 1 personal x 153 and 0 senior x 153. Federal AGI 1,200,000.00 is more than 252,203.00: the projection removes the personal and senior credits, line 32 = 0.00. The form's AGI Limitation Worksheet (PDF page 14) would give: c = 947,797 over 252,203.00; d = 947,797 / 2,500 rounded up = 380; e = 380 x 6 = 2280; f = 1 boxes on lines 7 and 9; g = 2280 x 1 = 2280; h = 153; i = 153 - 2280 = 0 (zero or less enters 0); line 32 = 0. Line 33 = 129,677.71 - 0.00 = 129,677.71; no other credits (lines 34 to 47 nil), line 48 = 129,677.71. Form check: Schedule X (PDF page 75) on 1,194,294.00, as bands without the surtax = 127,734.77 (from the printed base: 127,734.78) (line 31); Behavioral Health Services Tax (PDF page 16, line 62 worksheet) = (1,194,294.00 - 1,000,000.00) x 1% = 1,942.94; line 31 + line 62 = 129,677.71, the same as the folded brackets' 129,677.71; the printed base gives 129,677.72, a cent off from its rounded base; expected uses the bands as numbers. State income tax = 129,677.71.
